question: Before committing to an SLA for a new agentic workflow, a delivery lead wants to run a structured feedback session with business stakeholders to align on model selection criteria, following Anthropic's guidance on choosing a model. Which factors should the lead explicitly gather from stakeholders during this session? (Select all that apply)
options: A) The speed and latency requirements the application needs, including whether premium fast-mode pricing is acceptable
B) The budget constraints for both development and production usage
C) The exact number of parameters in the underlying model architecture
D) Which specific data center rack the model's weights are physically stored on
E) The capabilities the model must support to meet the workflow's functional requirements
correct_answers: A) The speed and latency requirements the application needs, including whether premium fast-mode pricing is acceptable
B) The budget constraints for both development and production usage
E) The capabilities the model must support to meet the workflow's functional requirements
explanations: Correct. Speed, including whether fast mode's premium pricing is an acceptable tradeoff, is one of the key criteria the guidance names for selecting a model.
Correct. Cost, covering both development and production budget, is explicitly named as one of the criteria to establish up front.
Incorrect. Anthropic does not publish underlying parameter counts, and this figure is not part of the documented selection criteria stakeholders should weigh in on.
Incorrect. Physical infrastructure location is not published information and has no bearing on the documented model selection criteria.
Correct. Anthropic's model selection guidance names capabilities as one of the key criteria to establish before choosing a model.
